# chore: bump wasm-pvm-cli to 0.8.0

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

## Summary

- Bumps the PVM compiler from `wasm-pvm-cli@0.7.1` → `0.8.0` across CI workflows (`build.yml`, `sizes.yml`), `scripts/start.sh`, `README.md`, and `docs/src/getting-started.md`.
- No SDK, adapter, or example-code changes needed — 0.8.0 is drop-in for this project.
- Measured PVM output is ~3.8 KB smaller across every example (near-constant, fixed-overhead reduction); WASM output is unchanged.

| Example | 0.7.1 PVM | 0.8.0 PVM | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| all-ecalli | 50 549 | 46 735 | −3 814 |
| authorizer | 17 474 | 13 650 | −3 824 |
| ecalli-test | 59 878 | 56 075 | −3 803 |
| fibonacci | 21 266 | 17 431 | −3 835 |
| library | 58 778 | 54 959 | −3 819 |
| pastebin | 46 753 | 42 916 | −3 837 |

Doc size claims (Logger/LogMsg/strUtf8 deltas) are feature overheads, not per-example totals, and remain valid under 0.8.0.

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo install wasm-pvm-cli@0.8.0 --locked` succeeds
- [x] `npm run build` compiles WASM → PVM for all examples with the new compiler
- [x] `npm test` — 33/33 SDK tests, 14 accumulate, 17 refine, 7 authorize, 9 pastebin, 8+25 library all pass
- [ ] CI `build` + `Artifact Sizes` workflows pass with the new cache key
